Title: Diagnosis of test `testGenerateURLFragment`
Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` is not escaping any HTML code; instead, it is using its input `toolTipText` as is. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

messages.content: [".ZipArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream)", ".ZipArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream, java.lang.String)", ".ZipArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream, java.lang.String, boolean)", ".ZipArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream, java.lang.String, boolean, boolean)", ".getNextZipEntry()", ".readFirstLocalFileHeader(byte[])", ".processZip64Extra(org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipLong, org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipLong)", ".read(byte[], int, int)", ".readStored(byte[], int, int)", ".close()", ".readFully(byte[])", ".supportsDataDescriptorFor(org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveEntry)"]

The failing test is `testReadingOfFirstStoredEntry` in the class `ZipArchiveInputStreamTest`. It fails on comparing the content of the zip entry read by `ZipArchiveInputStream.getNextZipEntry()` followed by reading the entry data via the input stream. The failure indicates that the first byte of the read data is 0 but expected 100 ('d').

Based on the failing test, the following methods are related to this issue:
- ZipArchiveInputStream.getNextZipEntry()
- ZipArchiveInputStream.read(byte[], int, int)
- ZipArchiveInputStream.readStored(byte[], int, int)
- ZipArchiveInputStream.readFirstLocalFileHeader(byte[])

The failure likely lies in reading the stored entry data, i.e., uncompressed data from the zip entry after the header was processed. To further investigate, I will first retrieve the code of the method `ZipArchiveInputStream.getNextZipEntry()` because it is the entry point in the test for reading the next entry and its metadata. Then I will check how data read is delegated inside the class.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
